properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.cleanup-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for expired session cleanup job.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.continue-on-error
properties.description: Whether initialization should continue when an error occurs when applying a schema script.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.flush-mode
properties.description: Sessions flush mode. Determines when session changes are written to the session store.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.platform
properties.description: Platform to use in initialization scripts if the @@platform@@ placeholder is used. Auto-detected by default.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.save-mode
properties.description: Sessions save mode. Determines how session changes are tracked and saved to the session store.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.schema
properties.description: Path to the SQL file to use to initialize the database schema.

properties.name: spring.session.jdbc.table-name
properties.description: Name of the database table used to store sessions.
